text: attempt 1 begins

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Current target is on rails, but there're still military vehicles and anti-air weaponry.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Destroy the target.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: But HQ has made it clear that no harm should come to civilians and no damage is to be done to public facilities.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: But, any aircraft shot down could land in civilian territory.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: No point arguing. That's how war is these days.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Do you have visual on the anti-air radar vehicles? They should be close.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Yup.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Locked!

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Intercept! Fire the AA! Get the radar vehicle out of there!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: It's poppin' off now, Trigger. The war has officially begun.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: The anti-air radar vehicle's been destroyed! They're going for the radar car!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: They've got their anti-air guns aimed right at us.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: It's an air raid! We're being attacked by enemy aircraft!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: We're using the containers now!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Those weapons are meant for tactical flexibility!

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Requesting permission to move the vehicle!

speaker: Erusean Base
text: We can't wait any longer! We need interceptors now!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Target destroyed. Three to go. Continue to engage at your discretion.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Enemy interceptors inbound!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Prepare to engage in 30 seconds.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Wilco. Here they come.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Take them down.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Okay, recruits. Pay attention to who's on what side.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: The newest IFF is connected to our entire force via satellites. It's reliable, so trust your radars.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Trigger, there's one more to go!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Good work, Trigger. The enemy's a lovely pile of scrap.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Friendly aircraft lost!

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: Target lock! Firing!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Mage 2, watch the enemy on your six!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Everything's been burned down.

speaker: Golem 4 Footpad
text: Golem 4, Fox 2!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Fox 2!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: The clouds don't just affect your field of vision; they also mess with your HUD and radar.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: The seekers can sometimes lose their lock-on to their targets too.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Get away from that vehicle! Now!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Break!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Missile evaded.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Mage 1, launching missile.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Locked.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Breaking! I need to evade!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: They've got the numbers and the strength.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Target is hit!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Enemy's got a lock! Breaking!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: You're low on special weaponry.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Anti-air guns down.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Enemy has entered clouds! In pursuit!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: That was the last radar vehicle! Great work!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Pull the enemy aircraft away from the base!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Radar vehicles destroyed but the interceptor shows no sign of retreating. Take it out.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Continue with the mission.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Crush as many as you can.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Enemy transports are taxiing.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Missile away.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: They're losing it after their allies on the ground were taken out.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Can't say I blame them.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Only aim over clear ground.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Skoll 3! You have to bail out now!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Golem 1! Enemy will crash in a residential area!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Just worry about staying alive for now.

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: No, they're not linked to the radar vehicles! Launch manually!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Redo the setup!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Here's some feedback for those war merchants!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Write your manuals in a language we can understand!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: They fled into the clouds.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Wait. So you want us to take down the enemy without damaging any public facilities?

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: That's gonna be a circus.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage 2, locked.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Enemy dodged! Continuing attack!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Target is in range of guns.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Golem 2, Fox 2.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Fire anti-air guns! Now!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Missile! Evading!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Five targets remaining.

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Bandit acquired. Initiating attack.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: All aircraft residential area is below you!

speaker: Erusean Fighter
text: Enemy missile detected!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Four targets remaining.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Huh?!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Keep your mind focused!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Three targets remaining.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Enemy transport destroyed. There's more.

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Launch preparations complete! Bolts are free! Whenever you're ready!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: Stand clear 15 meters!

speaker: Erusean Engineer
text: UAVs ready to launch! Away!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: What happened?!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Status report!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Multiple bogeys on radar! They're close!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Wait... they're being launched!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: You're cleared to engage! They're probably hostile!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Judgin' by the way they look and move, they've gotta be drones!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Well-spotted, Clown. No doubt about it, we're dealing with UAVs.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: But that doesn't change a thing. Just think of them as somewhat clever decoys.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Take them all down!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: These drones have great agility. All aircraft, you know what high-G turns are, right? Use them.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: HQ, this is Golem 1. Bandits confirmed as UAVs.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Repeat. Bandits are drones.

speaker: IUN-PKF HQ
text: Golem 1, that doesn't matter. Destroy all enemy fighters and get out.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: It doesn't matter?

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: He's saying, "The war can change in an instance. Get over it."

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Yeah, I just wish they'd just give us a bit more warning.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Feels like I'm riding a rollercoaster up here.

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: I've maneuvered behind the enemy!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Golem 2, Fox 2.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mage 2, Fox 2.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Locked!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Shit! I got an enemy in front of me and behind me!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Enemy UAV confirmed destroyed. Hell yeah.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Golem Squadron, you're not going to let Mage get all the glory, are you?

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: I'm buying dinner for anyone who takes down an enemy.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: There's a bar I want to try.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: You're doing good.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Just two more!

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Crap. The aircraft is icing up. I'm getting a warning.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Get out of the clouds. The ice will melt.

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: I'm iced up!

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Fox 2!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Golem 2, the enemy is reading you.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: What the? Where'd he go?

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: One to go! Let's get through this without any casualties!

speaker: Golem 4 Footpad
text: Golem 4, Fox 2!

speaker: Golem 3 Boggard
text: I'm in his blind spot! He's mine!

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: The enemy knows a few moves, but that's about it.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: Just chase them down and pull the trigger.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Clouds are screwing up the accuracy.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: Trigger, don't let them give you the runaround. Take them down one at a time.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: Nice kill, Trigger! Enemy aircraft confirmed down!

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: The skies are clear. Nice work, everyone.

speaker: AWACS Sky Keeper
text: Mission complete. RTB.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: No casualties. We couldn't have done any better. Returning to base.

speaker: Golem 2 Brownie
text: I don't know. Maybe the bandits we took down caused civilian casualties.

speaker: Mage 1 Clown
text: No point arguin'. That's how war is these days.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: You shoot, someone gets killed.

speaker: Golem 1 Knocker
text: The guys in charge take care of the rest.
